title: awslabs.cost-analysis-mcp-server: Boot error in Windows 11 environment
body:
### Describe the bug

When I started the Cost Analysis MCP Server in a Windows 11 environment, the following error occurred.

```
\Lib\site-packages\awslabs\cost_analysis_mcp_server\static\patterns\__init__.py", line 8, in <module>
     BEDROCK = f.read()
UnicodeDecodeError: 'cp932' codec can't decode byte 0x88 in position 1233: illegal multibyte sequence
```


### Expected Behavior

MCP Server starts successfully.

### Current Behavior

```
\Lib\site-packages\awslabs\cost_analysis_mcp_server\static\patterns\__init__.py", line 8, in <module>
     BEDROCK = f.read()
UnicodeDecodeError: 'cp932' codec can't decode byte 0x88 in position 1233: illegal multibyte sequence
```


### Reproduction Steps

This occurs when you enable MCP Server in a Windows environment and start the server.

### Possible Solution

After manually changing line 6 of cost_analysis_mcp_server/static/patterns/__init__.py to specify UTF-8, it started up.

```
.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f
```

### Additional Information/Context

_No response_

### OS

Windows 11

### Server

cost-analysis-mcp-server

### Server Version

_No response_

### Region experiencing the issue

ap-northeast-1

_No response_

title: feat: cdk flow
body:
*Issue #, if available:*

*Description of changes:*

This PR enhances the CDK MCP server with an improved implementation workflow diagram, better Bedrock Agent schema generation handling, and fixes Lambda Powertools resources path resolution.

## Changes
1. Enhanced BedrockAgentSchema Tool

- Save fallback scripts to files instead of returning verbose content in JSON responses
- Generate path-aware code examples showing proper CDK integration with generated schemas
- Add step-by-step guidance with best practices for schema usage
- Improve error handling and diagnostics

2. Added CDK Implementation Workflow Diagram

- Added comprehensive mermaid diagram to README showing the full CDK implementation process
- Included specialized flows for Bedrock Agent Action Groups schema generation
- Added decision paths for different implementation approaches
- Used high-contrast styling for better readability

3. Fixed Lambda Powertools Resources

- Fixed path resolution in lambda_powertools_loader.py
- Enhanced error messages with path information
- Ensured compatibility with resource URIs like lambda-powertools://cdk

4. Deleted duplicated GenAI CDK Construct md files
